label: rem:qbeta-c-k-closed-forms-derivation
title: Open derivation paths, precision leverage, and SDP evidence for the $c_k$
html:
Derivation paths

Three formal derivation paths stand open:

  1. Khovanov–Rozansky polynomial at finite q: Compute \mathrm{Kh}(L)(q, t) for the typed-\mathbf{B}_3 Markov-closure link L at the substrate q_0 (not merely q = 1). The Taylor coefficients should return c_4, c_5, c_6, c_7.
  2. KLR canonical-basis trace formula: Calculate the per-Wedderburn-block canonical-basis Markov trace at orders \varepsilon^8, \varepsilon^{10}, \varepsilon^{12}. The explicit per-block trace formula is required.
  3. Spectral-sequence stratification: Currently declined; the framework lacks a suitable candidate spectral sequence.

Comparison with extracted values

Rung Conjectured closed form Residual against extraction Categorical interpretation
c_4 c_3 \cdot b^4 = -2 \cdot b^4 0.9% residual Hopf Jones \times Kashiwara b^4 correction (multiplicative mixing)
c_5 -(b^2 + 1/2) 2.4% residual Kashiwara b^2 + half-Hopf integer offset (mixed)
c_6 c_3^2 \cdot b^2 = 4 \cdot b^2 14% residual Hopf Jones squared \times Kashiwara b^2
c_7 c_3^3 = -8 signed error +114\% Hopf Jones cubed

Match quality degrades at higher k. For c_7, the signed relative error is approximately 114\% (magnitude error 86\%). One retains the conjecture because the N=7 correction's leverage on the cumulative \mathfrak{Q}_\beta residual operates at the 10^{-13} scale. Any c_7 \in [-100, +100] closes the gap to within 10^{-4} ppb, leaving the numerical value highly under-determined.

Precision

The +6.02 ppb residual at N=3 recorded for this ladder, and the sub-1 ppb figures the higher rungs (c_4 to c_7) reach, are not a current statement that the 100\times accuracy target for \mathfrak{Q}_\beta is met. Both are properties of a cell the framework has since retired, and they are quoted here as a record of that cell, not as a prediction.

Two scopings apply, and neither was present when those figures were first written:

  1. Loop parameter. The ladder above was built with the auxiliary loop parameter z_{\mathrm{aux}} = \sqrt{q}/(q+1), whereas the canonical Markov parameter is z = q^3/(q^2+1). No counterpart of the c_k ladder at z = q^3/(q^2+1) has yet been derived.
  2. Functional. The single-wrap baseline underlying that ladder evaluates at z = 1 (the coordinate sum), which is not a root of the two-row Markov faithfulness condition y_{(1^3)}(z) = 0.

Against the 7.797 ppb target, the bare Markov-trace evaluation at z = q^3/(q^2+1) with zero c_k rungs sits at 1.668\times10^{8} ppb — a miss of 2.139\times10^{7} relative to target — whereas the +6.02 ppb figure above evaluates the five-rung z_{\mathrm{aux}} ladder on the z = 1 coordinate-sum cell. The two numbers evaluate distinct functionals and must not be conflated.

Under the three-calibration discipline, the higher rungs are calibration-anchored fits: they encode the CODATA datum they are matched to, so they are a calibration record rather than a prediction, and any downstream claim relying on them must declare that dependency.

Evidence

A 50-decimal-place SDP-T_\beta sweep at z_{\mathrm{aux}} = \sqrt{q}/(q+1) recorded the following numerical extractions:

c_2 extracted = -1.0171   (vs framework -1)
c_3 extracted = -2.0098   (pre-reanchoring value; see anchor table below)
c_4 extracted = -1.1435   (empirical sweep)
c_5 extracted = -1.2229   (empirical sweep)
c_6 extracted = +3.4976   (empirical sweep)
c_7 extracted = +57.149   (empirical sweep)

Anchor dependence of c_3. At z_{\mathrm{aux}} = \sqrt{q}/(q+1), re-evaluating c_3 across the substrate anchors gives:

anchor c_3 at z_{\mathrm{aux}} = \sqrt{q}/(q+1)
proton (m_{\mathfrak{p}}/m_e anchor) -2.06934257711516783787971951725
muon, CODATA 2022 -2.019860311874005
muon, CODATA 2018 -2.020200233

With the eigenphase evaluated instead at z = q^3/(q^2+1) on the proton anchor, the same ratio gives -974.43, reflecting the loop-parameter sensitivity quantified in the previous section.

The other five entries are recorded, not verified. No current computation publishes -1.1435, -1.2229, +3.4976 or +57.149 today — the canonical extraction stops after one rung by design, because extracting a rung by inverting the target drives the next residual to exactly zero. They are retained as the calibration record they were, and should not be cited as current extractions.

The empirical c_k are fits: each is extracted by matching the truncated product to the measured CODATA \mathfrak{Q}_\beta value, so it encodes the datum it is matched against. That is a calibration tautology, not a derivation, and it is why the rungs carry no predictive content. What the conjectures above propose is a categorical interpretation of those extracted constants — a closed form that would make them derived rather than matched. Until such a form is exhibited, the ladder is a calibration record.
